asset.description: DexBench's kinematic cage box l2b1 dressed as PSL 261014's carton in that place. Not a pool package: the body, collider and physics runtime variants are object_library/box_krpost_fc_04's, referenced; the carton drawn over it is bought material licensed for the E2 scene only. This sidecar only names the variant sets the reference brings, so a spawn selects its engine's the way it does on the package.
